body:
Using the provided MRP - can confirm this behaviour only exhibits in Compatibility mode.

```
Godot v4.4.dev (dc5f1b7a2)
 - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 11 Dec 2024 15:35:54 +0000 on Wayland
 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor
 - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility)
 - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (nvidia; 565.77)
 - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900KF (24 threads)
```

I have also noticed 3D view in the Editor seems to show the same inconsistency with buffer clears between Compatibility mode and the other renderers:

Compatibility:
![compatibility editor](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0c95b832-f575-4f6e-aa14-8e32287bc3bd)

Forward+:
![forward+ editor](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f8396dbd-57b5-4baf-9010-bdc67363a5db)

Interestingly, disabling the `Glow` post-processing effect before switching to Compatibility renderer fixes the issue, but the issue returns after re-enabling the effect and persists for the remainder of that session even if the effect is disabled again (until something else clears the buffer, like resizing the window). Feels like some flag might be getting set by the effect and not unset.
